_comment: apps/Festival (commerce #521 M18). The festival demo has no entities of its own: every right comes from the commerce
libraries' layers. They grant their buyer and seller types to @authenticated and narrow every row through the
organizations row policy (a seller's members) or their own access rules (a buyer's orders, tickets, invoices), so the
application only binds the libraries' slots. Administrators are the platform: seller approvals, trader data, DSA
notices (Commerce), shipping staff (Shipping), moderation (Moderation, which Commerce uses for notice and action).
Nothing is granted anonymously through /spark/po or /spark/queries: the public storefront reads published events and
products through the libraries' own public endpoints.
